name: v25_comp_reversal_slow_decay
hypothesis: v24 competitor-return reversal had strong Sharpe but excessive turnover; smoothing competitor returns and raising decay may preserve signal while lowering turnover.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_mean(rel_ret_comp, 5), 60), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 126), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Direct repair of mL8jgJkX high turnover; target TO <=25%, Fitness >=1.10.

name: v25_comp_reversal_no_intraday_slow
hypothesis: Remove close-open reversal to reduce turnover/correlation, leaving competitor-return reversal and competitor breadth/authority as the core.
expression: 0.65 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_mean(rel_ret_comp, 5), 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_comp, 126), industry)
notes: Tests whether the relationship-return channel can stand without the accepted close-open parent.

name: v25_comp_reversal_hump
hypothesis: Hump over a fast relationship-return signal may reduce turnover without collapsing to LOW_TURNOVER as it did for slow accounting fields.
expression: hump(0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * rel_ret_comp, 20), industry) + 0.30 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_com_rk_au, 60), industry))
notes: Operator repair; submit only if turnover enters the 1%-25% band and corr clears.

name: v25_comp_reversal_option_spread_mix
hypothesis: Blend the high-Sharpe competitor-return reversal with the near-miss option breakeven spread to reduce reliance on close-open and improve option fitness.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_mean(rel_ret_comp, 5), 60), industry) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Crossover of the two v24 repair targets; watch both turnover and option-skew/reversal correlation.

name: v25_option_spread_long_window
hypothesis: The v24 option breakeven spread was near-miss; a longer rank window and higher decay may improve Fitness by reducing turnover noise.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: Direct repair of vRLjkQdw near-miss; compare against option-skew ACTIVE.

name: v25_option_spread_hump
hypothesis: Hump on the near-miss option breakeven spread may reduce turnover while keeping the short-window option pressure signal.
expression: hump(0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 20), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry))
notes: Hump repair on a faster option signal, unlike the slow-accounting v23 hump.

name: v25_option_spread_low_iv_mix
hypothesis: Combine directional option breakeven pressure with low implied-minus-realized volatility to improve option-only information without share-count or accounting anchors.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-(close / open - 1))
notes: Keeps the repair within option data plus a small accepted timing parent.

name: v25_option_spread_dilution_small
hypothesis: Use share-count dilution only as a 30% auxiliary to lift option breakeven fitness while avoiding share-count as the main high-correlation driver.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252) / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(rel_num_part, 126), industry)
notes: High correlation risk by design; local corr gate decides.
